newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere aims to regularise share trade.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere aims to regularise share trade.

text.p: Lagardere said in a financial advertisement that it planned to intervene on the Bourse from today to regularise trading in new Lagardere shares issued due to the exercise of warrants.

Lagardere said this was to "soften the price distortion" between the new shares and existing shares. Lagardere added it could progressively sell part of the ordinary shares it holds itself for the new shares.
Five warrants Lagardere SCA give the right to subscribe to two new shares until June 1997.
